import hashlib,json,os,pathlib,subprocess,sys,time
root=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent; setup=json.loads((root/'setup.json').read_text()); stage=sys.argv[1]
assert stage in ['client','release','generate','use']
target=root/('build-generate-clean' if stage=='generate' else 'build-'+stage); assert not target.exists()
flags=setup['common_rustflags']; extra={'client':'','release':'','generate':' -Cprofile-generate='+str(root/'profiles'),'use':' -Cprofile-use='+str(root/'profiles/merged.profdata')}[stage]; flags+=extra
if stage=='use': assert (root/'profiles/merged.profdata').is_file()
env=dict(os.environ)
for key in ['CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS','LLVM_PROFILE_FILE']:env.pop(key,None)
fixed={'RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN':'1.99.0','CARGO_INCREMENTAL':'0','CARGO_BUILD_JOBS':'2','RUSTFLAGS':flags,'CARGO_TARGET_DIR':str(target)};env.update(fixed)
command=['cargo','build','--locked','--release','--target',setup['target'],'--manifest-path',str(root/('source/BasisRustClient/Cargo.toml' if stage=='client' else 'source/BasisRustServer/Cargo.toml')),'-p',('basis-rust-client' if stage=='client' else 'basis-server-console')]
log=root/('build-'+stage+'.log'); started=time.time(); print('START build '+stage,flush=True)
with log.open('w') as out:r=subprocess.run(command,env=env,stdout=out,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
record={'stage':stage,'command':command,'environment':fixed,'unset_environment':['CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS','LLVM_PROFILE_FILE'],'started_unix_seconds':started,'finished_unix_seconds':time.time(),'exit_code':r.returncode,'log':str(log)}
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest();record['log_sha256']=sha(log)
(root/('build-'+stage+'-attempt.json')).write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
if r.returncode:print('BUILD FAILED, inspect '+str(log));sys.exit(r.returncode)
binary=target/setup['target']/('release/basis-rust-client' if stage=='client' else 'release/basis-server-console');record.update(binary=str(binary),sha256=sha(binary),bytes=binary.stat().st_size)
fingerprints=list((target/setup['target']/'release/.fingerprint').glob('basis-rust-client-*/bin-basis-rust-client.json' if stage=='client' else 'basis-server-console-*/bin-basis-server-console.json'));assert len(fingerprints)==1
f=json.loads(fingerprints[0].read_text());assert f['rustflags']==flags.split(),f['rustflags'];record['cargo_fingerprint']=f;record['fingerprint_sha256']=sha(fingerprints[0]);record['profile_diagnostics']=[line for line in log.read_text().splitlines() if any(x in line.lower() for x in ['no profile data','profile data may be out of date','hash mismatch','profile data mismatch','missing profile','profile counter overflow'])]
manifest_path=root/'build-manifest.json';manifest=json.loads(manifest_path.read_text()) if manifest_path.exists() else {'setup':setup,'stages':{},'binary_sha256':{}}
manifest['stages'][stage]=record
if stage=='client':
 setup.update(client=record['binary'],client_sha256=record['sha256'],client_build_provenance=record);(root/'setup.json').write_text(json.dumps(setup,indent=2)+'\n');manifest['setup']=setup;manifest['binary_sha256']['client']=record['sha256']
if stage in ['release','use']:manifest['binary_sha256']['baseline' if stage=='release' else 'candidate']=record['sha256']
manifest_path.write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2)+'\n');print('END build '+stage+': '+record['sha256']+' profile diagnostics='+str(len(record['profile_diagnostics'])),flush=True)

import hashlib,json,pathlib,subprocess
root=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent; setup=json.loads((root/'setup.json').read_text()); exp=json.loads((root/'training/experiment.json').read_text()); assert len(exp['runs'])==2
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(); profiles=[]; training=[]
for entry in exp['runs']:
 r=json.loads((root/'training'/entry['name']/'validated-summary.json').read_text());assert r['valid'] and all(r['checks'].values()),entry['name']; assert r['exits']['server_exit_code']==0,r['exits']; training.append(r)
 for artifact in r['raw_profiles']:
  p=pathlib.Path(artifact['path']);assert p.stat().st_size>0 and sha(p)==artifact['sha256'];profiles.append(p)
assert len(profiles)==2 and set(profiles)==set((root/'profiles').glob('*.profraw'))
out=root/'profiles/merged.profdata';assert not out.exists()
cmd=[setup['llvm_profdata'],'merge','-o',str(out),*[str(p) for p in profiles]]
r=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True);(root/'profile-merge.log').write_text(r.stdout+r.stderr);assert r.returncode==0,r.stderr
show=[setup['llvm_profdata'],'show','--detailed-summary','--topn=10',str(out)];r=subprocess.run(show,capture_output=True,text=True);(root/'profile-show.log').write_text(r.stdout+r.stderr);assert r.returncode==0,r.stderr
profile={'training_experiment':exp,'training':training,'raw_profiles':[{'path':str(p),'bytes':p.stat().st_size,'sha256':sha(p)} for p in profiles],'merged_profile':{'path':str(out),'bytes':out.stat().st_size,'sha256':sha(out)},'llvm_profdata_sha256':sha(pathlib.Path(setup['llvm_profdata'])),'merge_command':cmd,'merge_output':(root/'profile-merge.log').read_text(),'show_command':show,'show_output':r.stdout+r.stderr}
(root/'profile-manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(profile,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps({'profiles':profile['raw_profiles'],'merged':profile['merged_profile'],'show':r.stdout+r.stderr},indent=2))

assert set(m['binary_sha256'])=={'baseline','candidate','client'}
for label in ['release','generate','use']:
 stage=m['stages'][label];assert sha(pathlib.Path(stage['binary']))==stage['sha256'];assert stage['cargo_fingerprint']['profile']==m['stages']['release']['cargo_fingerprint']['profile'];assert not stage['profile_diagnostics'],stage['profile_diagnostics']
assert m['stages']['release']['cargo_fingerprint']['rustflags']==[m['setup']['common_rustflags']]
assert m['stages']['generate']['cargo_fingerprint']['rustflags']==[m['setup']['common_rustflags'],'-Cprofile-generate='+str(root/'profiles')]
assert m['stages']['use']['cargo_fingerprint']['rustflags']==[m['setup']['common_rustflags'],'-Cprofile-use='+str(root/'profiles/merged.profdata')]
assert sha(pathlib.Path(m['setup']['client']))==m['setup']['client_sha256']
for f in [*p['raw_profiles'],p['merged_profile']]:assert sha(pathlib.Path(f['path']))==f['sha256']
m['comparison']='Same merged-source ordinary vs freshly trained PGO server, one shared ordinary Rust client,1500 fixed avatar workload';m['profile']=p;m['checks']=m['setup']['prior_checks'];m['local_build_helpers']={f:{'sha256':sha(root/f),'source':(root/f).read_text()} for f in ['build.py','merge-profile.py','finalize-build.py','drive-evaluation.py']};m['training_invocation']=['python3','-B','scripts/perf/train-avatar-pgo.py','--root',str(root),'--client',m['setup']['client']]
manifest_path.write_text(json.dumps(m,indent=2)+'\n');print('All build/profile hashes and effective flags verified; profile diagnostic count0. Ready for1500 evaluation.')

import json,pathlib,subprocess,sys,time
root=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent;repo=pathlib.Path.cwd()
def run(label,command,log):
 print('START '+label,flush=True)
 with (root/log).open('w') as out:r=subprocess.run(command,stdout=out,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 print('END '+label+' exit='+str(r.returncode),flush=True)
 return r.returncode
for name in ['merge-profile.py','finalize-build.py']:
 assert (root/name).is_file()
assert run('merge profiles',[sys.executable,'-B',str(root/'merge-profile.py')],'profile-controller.log')==0
assert run('PGO build',[sys.executable,'-B',str(root/'build.py'),'use'],'pgo-build-controller.log')==0
assert run('verify builds',[sys.executable,'-B',str(root/'finalize-build.py')],'finalize-controller.log')==0
setup=json.loads((root/'setup.json').read_text())
command=[sys.executable,'-B',str(repo/'scripts/perf/compare-avatar-revisions.py'),'--baseline',str(root/'build-release/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/release/basis-server-console'),'--candidate',str(root/'build-use/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/release/basis-server-console'),'--client',setup['client'],'--build-manifest',str(root/'build-manifest.json'),'--output',str(root/'evaluation'),'--clients','1500','--blocks','2','--warmup-seconds','45','--window-seconds','60','--server-cpus','2-9','--client-cpus','10-15']
status=run('ordinary/PGO evaluation',command,'evaluation-controller.log')
if status:
 saved=json.loads((root/'evaluation/summary.json').read_text());runs=saved['runs'];assert 0<len(runs)<8
 for r in runs:
  assert r.get('metrics') and {k for k,v in r['checks'].items() if not v}<={'zero_retransmits'}
  samples=[json.loads(l) for l in (root/'evaluation'/r['name']/'samples.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
  assert len({s['health']['extended']['reliable']['retransmits'] for s in samples})==1
 assert run('strict-flag diagnostic continuation',[sys.executable,'-B',str(root/'continue-series.py')],'continuation.log')==0
saved=json.loads((root/'evaluation/summary.json').read_text());assert len(saved['runs'])==8
print('COMPLETE eight evaluation processes; strict flags retained.',flush=True)

local_controller_source.source:
"""Continue this overload experiment while retaining every strict validation failure."""
import importlib.util,json,os,pathlib,signal,socket,sys
repo=pathlib.Path.cwd(); sys.path.insert(0,str(repo/'scripts/perf'))
from avatar_benchmark import run_workload,relevant_env,select_port,write_json
from avatar_tuning import run_order,sha256,summarize
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('compare',repo/'scripts/perf/compare-avatar-revisions.py'); compare=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(compare); settings=compare.settings
root=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent; output=root/'evaluation'; saved=json.loads((output/'summary.json').read_text()); experiment=saved['experiment']; runs=saved['runs']; artifacts=experiment['frozen']; workload=experiment['workload']
initial_count=len(runs)
assert 0<initial_count<8 and len(experiment['runs'])==initial_count
assert [(r['round'],r['variant']) for r in runs]==run_order(['baseline','candidate'],experiment['repeats'])[:initial_count]
assert all(r.get('metrics') and r.get('exits') for r in runs) and not all(r['valid'] for r in runs)
assert all({k for k,v in r['checks'].items() if not v} <= {'zero_retransmits'} for r in runs)
args=settings.parser().parse_args(['--server',artifacts['baseline']['path'],'--client',artifacts['client']['path'],'--server-config',artifacts['server_config']['path'],'--client-config',artifacts['client_config']['path'],'--output',str(root/'validation-only'),'--clients',str(workload['clients']),'--warmup-seconds',str(workload['warmup_seconds']),'--window-seconds',str(workload['window_seconds']),'--repeats',str(experiment['repeats']),'--server-cpus',workload['server_cpus'],'--client-cpus',workload['client_cpus'],'--rayon-threads','4','--tokio-workers','4','--client-workers','4','--port',str(workload['port']),'--health-port',str(workload['health_port'])])
settings.validate(args); args.output=output
assert {k:getattr(args,k) for k in workload}==workload
os.sched_setaffinity(0,set(experiment['coordinator_affinity']))

def interrupt(*_):
    for sig in (signal.SIGINT,signal.SIGTERM): signal.signal(sig,signal.SIG_IGN)
    raise KeyboardInterrupt
signal.signal(signal.SIGINT,interrupt); signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM,interrupt)

def save():
    write_json(output/'experiment.json',experiment)
    write_json(output/'summary.json',{'experiment':experiment,'runs':runs,'comparison':compare.aggregate(runs,experiment['repeats'])})

with settings.experiment_lock():
    env,cleared=settings.clean_environment(args.server_config,args.client_config)
    server_env=dict(env,BASIS_AVATAR_FLUSH_LANES='0',RAYON_NUM_THREADS='4',TOKIO_WORKER_THREADS='4')
    client_env=dict(env,BASIS_CLIENT_TOKIO_WORKERS='4',BASIS_AVATAR_DIAGNOSTICS='true')
    assert relevant_env(server_env)==experiment['runs'][0]['server_settings']
    assert relevant_env(client_env)==experiment['runs'][0]['client_settings']
    assert cleared==experiment['cleared_environment_keys']
    assert select_port(socket.SOCK_DGRAM,args.port)==args.port and select_port(socket.SOCK_STREAM,args.health_port)==args.health_port
    experiment['initial_coordinator_error']=experiment.pop('error')
    experiment['continuation']={'reason':'PGO cohort stopped on original strict gates. Continue the remaining scheduled process runs with identical source/binaries/controls and preserve every invalid flag. Do not replace cumulative gates with steady-state-only validity.','invocation':[sys.executable,str(pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve())],'sha256':sha256(pathlib.Path(__file__)),'strict_gates_unchanged':True,'allow_invalid_results':True}
    save()
    try:
        for i,(round_index,variant) in enumerate(run_order(['baseline','candidate'],experiment['repeats'])):
            if i<initial_count: continue
            entry={'name':f'{i+1:02d}-{variant}','round':round_index,'variant':variant,'server_settings':relevant_env(server_env),'client_settings':relevant_env(client_env)}
            assert not (output/entry['name']).exists()
            for artifact in artifacts.values(): assert sha256(pathlib.Path(artifact['path']))==artifact['sha256'],'Frozen artifact changed'
            for path,expected in experiment['tool_sha256'].items(): assert sha256(pathlib.Path(path))==expected,'Capture tool changed'
            assert sha256(pathlib.Path(__file__))==experiment['continuation']['sha256']
            experiment['runs'].append(entry); save(); print(f'START {entry["name"]} ({i+1}/8)',flush=True)
            args.server=pathlib.Path(artifacts[variant]['path'])
            run_workload(args,output/entry['name'],server_env,client_env)
            view=dict(experiment,frozen=dict(artifacts,server=artifacts[variant])); result=summarize(output/entry['name'],view,entry)
            runs.append(result); write_json(output/entry['name']/'validated-summary.json',result); save()
            m=result['metrics']; failed=[k for k,v in result['checks'].items() if not v]
            print(f'END {entry["name"]}: valid={result["valid"]} p50/p95={m["gap_p50_ms"]:.2f}/{m["gap_p95_ms"]:.2f}ms built={m["built_logical_avatar_work_per_second"]:.0f}/s CPU={m["server_cpu_cores"]:.2f}/{m["client_cpu_cores"]:.2f}; failed={failed}',flush=True)
    except (Exception,KeyboardInterrupt) as exc:
        experiment['error']=f'{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}'
        if len(runs)<len(experiment['runs']): runs.append({**experiment['runs'][-1],'valid':False,'error':experiment['error']})
        save(); raise
print('All eight attempted runs retained; strict validity remains explicit',flush=True)
